popCulture.creator: Pseudo-Apollodorus
popCulture.description: Last Crotopid king of Argos: he yields the throne to Danaus returning from Egypt — Apollodorus' peaceful surrender before the Danaid marriage-plot.

popCulture.title: Description of Greece
popCulture.creator: Pausanias
popCulture.description: Pausanias prefers a contest or expulsion version of Danaus' takeover — Gelanor as the displaced Argive king at the hinge of the Danaid arrival.

popCulture.title: Gelanor
popCulture.description: Son of Sthenelas; last pre-Danaid king of Argos in the Crotopid line.
